objective_vision_observations: The page features a handwritten note above a colorful printed label of an Irish whiskey bottle. The handwritten note is cursive and dark pen or ink on a white background. The label is bordered in gold with the text THE TYRCONNELL SINGLE MALT with an illustration of horse jockeys racing. The text below describes the whiskey as PURE POT STILL IRISH WHISKEY specially bottled for the Rt. Hon Peter Mandelson MP, Secretary of State for Northern Ireland 1999 to 2001 by Andrew A. Watt & Co in Ireland. The label includes alcohol volume 40% and product volume 70cl, with a note on Riverstown, Dundalk, Ireland. The label and handwritten note are placed centrally on the page with ample white margin around.
